thesis: Sylvan Library turns every draw step into a three-card selection puzzle and lets life become additional cards when the game demands raw velocity.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw two additional cards. If you do, choose two cards in your hand drawn this turn. For each of those cards, pay 4 life or put the card on top of your library.

competitiveTimeline.significance: From green control and Zoo to Legacy midrange and Commander, Sylvan Library became green’s most enduring bridge between card selection and life-payment card advantage.

playbook.role: Resolve the draw sequence carefully, distinguish cards drawn this turn from cards returned, and pay life only when the extra cards materially improve the clock or answer a threat. Shuffle effects greatly increase selection quality.

counterplay.directAnswers: Pressure life totals, remove the enchantment before multiple draw steps, and punish slow investment with tempo. Effects that deny searching or manipulate the top of the library can reduce its ceiling.
